name: musivault
description: A beautiful web application to manage and explore your music collection

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "cd backend && npm run dev" "wait-on -t 60000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5001 && cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test:run && npm --prefix backend run test:run
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
